Summary: Onboarding
Description: Register owners, tenants and family with DPDP consent; the committee approves before login.

Summary: Authentication and roles
Description: Secure sign-in, role-based access, permission matrix, guard allow-list.

Summary: Work requests
Description: Raise, assign, track, close and rate work requests with photo and history.

Summary: Notifications
Description: Notices and in-app notifications to residents.

Summary: Admin dashboard
Description: Committee dashboard, audit trail, vendor ratings, CSV export, estate overview.

Summary: Non-functional
Description: Security, privacy, HTTPS, availability, accessibility, testing and deployment.

Summary: AI-native workflows
Description: WhatsApp intake, AI triage, notice drafter, SLA escalation, weekly digest. AI suggests, a human confirms.

Summary: As a new resident, I want to register as owner, tenant or family with consent, so that I can get an account
Description: Form with name, email, flat, phone, type, password and DPDP consent tick.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a new resident / When they submit valid details with consent / Then the account is pending, the password is hashed and the committee is notified. Given no consent or a short password / When they submit / Then it is rejected with a message.

Summary: As a committee member, I want to approve or reject pending residents, so that only real residents can sign in
Description: Approvals queue on web and phone; suspend and remove supported.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a pending user / When the committee approves / Then the user can sign in and the decision is audited. Given a rejected user / When they sign in / Then they see a clear message.

Summary: As an owner, I want to add family or tenants to my flat, so that they get access under my flat
Description: Created pending in the owner's flat with a temporary password; committee approves.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given an owner with household permission / When they add a member / Then the member is pending in the owner's flat. Given a tenant or family member / When they try / Then 403.

Summary: As a committee member, I want to record tenant leases, so that I know who lives there and for how long
Description: Lease editor: dates, owner contact, police verification, agreement, parking; tenant sees days left.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given an approved tenant / When the committee saves a lease / Then the tenant is notified and sees it. Given another resident / When they read it / Then they cannot.

Summary: As a resident, I want to sign in securely, so that my data is protected
Description: Email and password, bcrypt hashes, httpOnly SameSite cookie, throttling.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given valid credentials / When I sign in / Then I get a session. Given five failures / When I try again / Then I am throttled.

Summary: As the committee, I want role checks on every route, so that residents cannot see each other's data
Description: auth, admin, can() middlewares; flat-wide visibility rule.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a resident / When they call an admin route / Then 403. Given no session / When they call any route / Then 401.

Summary: As the committee, I want to edit what owners, tenants and family may do, so that rules fit our society
Description: Permission matrix of nine permissions; defaults preserved on upgrade.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given the access screen / When I turn a permission off for a role / Then residents of that role get 403 for it.

Summary: As the committee, I want to switch features on or off, so that we only run what we need
Description: Flags for emergency, gate, contacts, notices, parking.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a flag is off / When a resident calls the feature / Then 403; admin unaffected.

Summary: As a guard, I want a restricted account, so that I can verify visitors and see nothing else
Description: Strict allow-list: me, password, gate verify/log/overview, pulse, notifications.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a guard / When they call any other route / Then 403. Given a guard / When they stay signed in while the app polls / Then the session persists.

Summary: As the committee, I want to reset a password and sign the user out everywhere
Description: Session bound to password fingerprint.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a reset / When the old session calls the API / Then 401.

Summary: As a resident, I want optional Google sign-in for my existing account
Description: ID-token verification; existing accounts only; off by default.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a configured client id / When a known email signs in with Google / Then a session starts. Given an unknown email / Then it is refused.

Summary: As a resident, I want to raise a request with category, details and photo, so that the committee can act
Description: Six categories; JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 5 MB with signature check.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given I can raise requests / When I submit a valid request / Then it is open and the committee is notified. Given a fake image / When I submit / Then it is rejected.

Summary: As a committee member, I want to assign a vendor and move the request forward, so that work gets done
Description: Forward-only open, assigned, in_progress, closed; vendor required.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given an open request / When I assign a vendor / Then status is assigned and the resident is notified. Given no vendor / When I move it / Then 409.

Summary: As a resident, I want to see my request history and comments, so that I can track it
Description: Tracker with timestamps from the audit trail; comments.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a request / When I open it / Then I see each status change with its time and comments.

Summary: As a resident, I want to see requests from my own flat only, so that family stays informed and others stay private
Description: Own plus own-flat visibility.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given two flats / When each lists requests / Then each sees only its own flat.

Summary: As a requester or owner, I want to rate resolved work once, so that quality is tracked
Description: 1-5 stars; family never rates; owner rates for them.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a closed request / When the requester rates / Then it is saved once. Given a family member / When they rate / Then refused.

Summary: As a committee member, I want a vendor directory, so that records are in one place
Description: Create, edit, delete vendors by trade.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given the committee / When I add a vendor / Then it appears in assignment choices.

Summary: As a resident, I want an alert for each status change, so that I know progress without asking
Description: In-app notifications and unread count.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given an assignment or status change / When it happens / Then the requester gets a notification; marking read clears the count.

Summary: As the committee, I want to post notices, so that residents are informed
Description: Headline and details; residents alerted.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a notice / When posted / Then approved residents are alerted and can read it. Given a resident / When they post / Then 403.

Summary: As a user, I want live updates without refresh, so that I see current data
Description: Clients poll /api/pulse and redraw only on change.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a data change / When the poll runs / Then the screen updates and the token changes only when visible data changed.

Summary: As a resident, I want to raise an emergency alert and see society contacts
Description: Alert with type and note, limited to five per hour; contacts list.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given an alert / When raised / Then the committee is notified; a sixth alert in an hour is refused.

Summary: As a committee member, I want a dashboard of open requests, SLA, categories and vendor ratings
Description: Stats endpoint and dashboard with 48h SLA.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given requests in different states / When I open the dashboard / Then counts match the data.

Summary: As a committee member, I want an audit trail, so that I know who did what and when
Description: Every state change writes audit; latest 200 shown.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given changes / When I open the audit / Then each shows actor, action and time. Given a resident / Then 403.

Summary: As a committee member, I want a CSV export of requests
Description: Download from admin.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given requests / When I export / Then a CSV with them downloads; non-admin gets 403.

Summary: As a committee member, I want an estate overview, so that I see everything at a glance
Description: One call returns residents, gate, parking, vehicles, workers numbers.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given the committee / When I open the dashboard / Then every headline number is present; non-admin gets 403.

Summary: As a resident, I want visitor gate passes, and as a guard I want to verify them
Description: QR token plus 6-digit code, validity window, single use, resident gate token, gate log.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a pass / When the guard verifies it / Then allowed once and logged; expired or reused passes are denied with a reason.

Summary: As the committee, I want vehicles, parking and workers registers
Description: Plate uniqueness, slot assignment, worker status.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given the registers / When I add, assign or free / Then validation and isolation hold.

Summary: Security hardening: CSP, CSRF origin check, parameterised SQL, secure headers
Description: Self-hosted assets, strict CSP, escaped output.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a cross-origin state-changing call / When sent / Then 403. Given the CSP / Then only self sources.

Summary: Automated tests: node:test, JUnit, Vitest
Description: Tests ship with every story; Node tests are the spec for the Java and React ports.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a change / When the suites run / Then all pass.

Summary: Java Spring Boot backend and React frontend, side by side (ADR 0001)
Description: Strangler migration in four phases with a frozen API contract.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given the Java backend / When the Node tests' scenarios run / Then the same responses are returned.

Summary: Deployment: Docker Compose, PostgreSQL, nginx, HTTPS, CI
Description: Compose, Dockerfiles, GitHub Actions workflow, deploy guide; live URL.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given the compose file / When started on a Docker host / Then the portal serves over HTTPS and healthchecks pass.

Summary: Accessibility pass (labels, contrast, keyboard)
Description: Check forms and navigation.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given each screen / When used with keyboard only / Then every action is reachable and inputs are labelled.

Summary: Acceptance testing with residents at the partner society
Description: Per docs/testing/acceptance-plan.md.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given permission and test accounts / When residents do the task script / Then results are recorded and no critical defect remains.

Summary: Privacy and consent documents, partner permission template
Description: docs/privacy-and-consent.md.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given the society / When testing starts / Then a signed permission and data handover plan exist.

Summary: As a WhatsApp-only resident, I want to message the society number to raise a request, and get status replies
Description: Webhook /api/whatsapp/webhook maps the sender's registered phone to a flat; replies logged and sent when a provider is configured.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a registered phone / When it sends a message / Then a request is created with source whatsapp and a reply is sent. Given an unknown number / Then it is asked to register and no request is created. Given 'status' / Then the latest requests are listed.

Summary: As a committee member, I want every new request triaged by AI, so that I can assign faster
Description: Category, priority, one-line summary, suggested vendor; LLM with rule-based fallback; PII stripped first.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a new request / When it is created / Then suggestions are stored and visible to the committee only. Given no API key / Then rules are used. Given text with phone or email / Then they are removed before any model call.

Summary: As a committee member, I want to confirm AI-suggested assignments, so that a human stays accountable
Description: Suggestions never assign on their own.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a suggestion / When I confirm or change the vendor / Then the assignment and my id are audited. Given no click / Then no assignment happens.

Summary: As a committee member, I want an AI notice drafter, so that notices are written quickly
Description: Rough bullets in, draft out; the committee edits and posts.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given rough text / When I ask for a draft / Then a draft is returned and nothing is posted until I post.

Summary: As a committee member, I want requests older than 48 hours escalated automatically
Description: Timer checks open requests; escalation recorded once; committee and requester notified.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given an open request older than 48h / When the timer runs / Then it is escalated once, notified and audited.

Summary: As a committee member, I want a weekly AI digest of what is pending
Description: Digest of open, unassigned, escalated, urgent and pending users.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given the week's data / When the digest is requested / Then the counts match the data.

Summary: As a committee member, I want only real requests from public WhatsApp groups turned into tickets, so that chatter does not flood the queue
Description: Message gate before intake: request / question / chatter. Chatter is ignored without a reply, unsure messages wait in a Needs review queue for the committee; unknown senders in groups get no reply; confirmations go privately to the sender.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a group message that is chatter / When it reaches the webhook / Then no ticket and no reply; Given an unsure message / Then it is queued and the committee can create the request or dismiss it; Given a clear fault report / Then a request is logged and the sender is told privately.

Summary: As a resident, I want to raise requests through Telegram, so that I can report problems without the portal app
Description: Telegram webhook, contact-share linking, /start onboarding, same gate as WhatsApp, emergencies from messages.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given a linked resident / When they message a real problem / Then a request with source telegram is created and they get the number; Given chatter / Then nothing is created.

Summary: As a committee member, I want new complaints emailed to me with buttons to assign and approve each stage, so that I can run requests from my inbox when I am not on the dashboard
Description: Email desk: stage tracker, next step first, signed 7-day links, confirm page replays the dashboard API, follow-up email per stage; registrations, review messages and emergencies too.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given no admin on the dashboard / When a request arrives / Then an email offers Assign; Given I confirm Assign / Then it is assigned, audited, the resident is told and a follow-up email offers Approve start; and so on until resolved.

Summary: Fix: Telegram bot says not registered after the free host restarts
Description: Free plan wipes the database on sleep/redeploy; tester recreated at boot from env.
Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then): Given SEED_TELEGRAM_PHONE / When the app starts / Then the linked T-101 tester exists.
